neighbours.label: the word 'guilty' / 'guilt' (including split pieces like GUIL|TY)
fire: After a short trial the jury found the defendant guilty of fraud.
He felt a deep sense of guilt for missing his daughter's recital.

Years later the guilt still kept her awake at night.
Eating a second slice of cake is my favourite guilty pleasure.
The accused man insisted he was not guilty and demanded a retrial.
Survivors often struggle with guilt long after the accident.
quiet: After a short trial the jury found the defendant innocent of fraud.
He felt a deep sense of regret for missing his daughter's recital.
My mother always made me feel bad about leaving food on the plate.
The senator admitted to two counts of tax evasion on Monday.
Years later the memory still kept her awake at night.
Eating a second slice of cake is my favourite little treat.
